high_level_description: stc brand style, a close-up portrait of a young woman in a light gray hijab looking contemplatively at a rose gold iPhone against a warm wooden wall.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A warm-toned wooden wall with vertical plank grain, softly lit with a pink-tinted glow and rendered with shallow depth of field.

elements.desc: A young woman wearing a light gray hijab, looking down with a contemplative expression, her face turned slightly to the right.
A rose gold iPhone held in the woman's hand, the focal point of her gaze.
